definitionZh: :active-view-Terrival CSS伪类在视图过渡正在进行时匹配文档的根元素(active),并在过渡完成后停止匹配.
sourceDefinition: The :active-view-transition CSS pseudo-class matches the root element of a document when a view transition is in progress (active) and stops matching once the transition has completed.
